title: Leo Learns to Share | Little Safari Friends
description:
Join Leo the little lion, Ellie the elephant and Gigi the giraffe on a sunny safari adventure! When Leo finds three delicious mangoes, he discovers that sharing makes friendship stronger and playtime happier. An original, gentle animated story for young children about kindness, friendship and sharing.

Subscribe to Little Safari Friends for more fun animal stories and positive life lessons!

#LittleSafariFriends #KidsStories #Sharing #AnimalStories #Kindness #PreschoolStories

scenes.narration: On a sunny morning, Leo the little lion found three delicious mangoes under a tree.
scenes.caption: Leo finds three mangoes!

scenes.narration: His friends Ellie the elephant and Gigi the giraffe came over. They were hungry too.
scenes.caption: Ellie and Gigi are hungry too.

scenes.narration: Leo wanted every mango for himself. Then he noticed his friends had nothing to eat.
scenes.caption: Leo stops and thinks.

scenes.narration: Leo shared the mangoes, and they took turns enjoying the sweet fruit together.
scenes.caption: Sharing makes everyone smile!

scenes.narration: Leo learned that sharing makes a good day even better. See you next time, safari friends!
scenes.caption: The end! Be kind and share.
